title: 636017 Move CRM report action tooltips to report objects
summary: CRM report action tooltips are moved from page actions to report objects, and this change is propagated across all country forks to maintain consistency.
key_points: 16 CRM reports now have tooltips defined at the report level instead of on page actions
Duplicate tooltips removed from page actions in W1 and all country forks
Change applied to all country layers including APAC, BE, CH, DACH, NA, NL, NO, and RU
Tooltips are now defined once and apply wherever reports are invoked
Metadata-only change with no runtime behavior impact
quote: Moves the report action ToolTips for the CRM / Marketing reports off the page actions that run them and onto the report objects themselves.
